Egg Freezing and Embryo Banking Market Size 
and Forecast 2025 to 2034
The global  egg freezing  and embryo  banking  market  size was accounted  at 
USD 5.41 billion in 2024 and is anticipated  to be worth around  USD 25.63 
billion  by 2034, registering  at a double -digit CAGR of 16.83% from 2025 
to 2034. The increasing  cases of infertility  cases,  late pregnancies,  and 
other lifestyle  factors  are contributing  to the growth  of the market .
Egg Cross -Border Fertility Tourism: Where and 
Why Patients Travel
An increasingly  important  trend is patients  traveling  abroad  for fertility  
care, a practice  often termed  fertility  tourism  or cross-border  
reproductive  care. By 2024, OVU’s  internal  data showed  that over 60% of 
fertility  patients  consider  going overseas  for treatment . Several  thousand  
people  cross borders  seeking  IVF, donor eggs, or surrogacy,  motivated  by 
factors  like lower cost, legal access,  or availability  of specific  procedures .
